title: Canonical native proper comparison respects the units
statement: For a finite field k₀, a prime l distinct from its characteristic, a morphism of k₀-schemes f and a compactification c, ProperNormalization k₀ l f c holds for the specified canonical comparison of [def-sf-native-weil-induction-comparison-data].

proof.text: The exact-right composition comparison respects its unit. The induced natural-isomorphism comparison does too, and the underlying natural isomorphism is literal identity. The right-derived composition comparison and the exact-forgetful comparison respect their units. Combine these equations, and cancel the adjacent exact localization factors. Specialize to the native proper direct image.
